json_schema.description: The stall sweeper nudged a goal's owner. NOT a contract — a poke expects no reply, and pairing it with one would make every poke outstanding work in its own right. It IS the backoff counter: the number of goal_poke events for a goal is that goal's sweep epoch, so the exponent and the poke-dedup key are the same number and neither is stored separately. NOT spillable: a poke recorded only locally is invisible to the other host's dedup, so the next sweep would double-poke.
